settings.heading: You know exactly where this is.
settings.body:
It starts with a phone and a water bottle. By Wednesday it's a clipboard, two chargers, gloves, a flashlight, a jacket, and whatever you ate at 2am.

You brake for a four-wheeler and half of it's in the footwell. You know it's in here somewhere. You've been looking for four minutes. You're due at a dock in twenty.
settings.callout: Nobody designed this space for a person. It was designed to move freight, and you were an afterthought.

settings.title: What it does
settings.text: Straps to the passenger seat back. Deep bottom pockets for bulk. Elastic sleeves for cables, tools and a flashlight. A padded slot for a tablet. A flat document pocket that fits a clipboard without folding it.

settings.title: How it works
settings.text: Two cam-buckle straps over the seat back, one anchor strap behind the headrest. About two minutes. No tools. Nothing modified — so nothing to clear with your carrier, and it comes with you to the next truck.

settings.title: Why it's different
settings.text: Almost everything sold for this is a car organizer with truck keywords. The straps don't reach a Class 8 seat and the panel sags the moment you load it. The CS-01 was sized against real cab dimensions and box-stitched at every load point.

settings.heading: The CS-01 gives all of it one place.

settings.title: Nothing moves when you brake
settings.text: Defined pockets and elastic retention. Gear stays where you put it.

settings.title: You stop hunting
settings.text: One place for everything. No more four-minute searches for the same three items.

settings.title: You get the seat back
settings.text: The passenger seat becomes a seat again.

settings.title: Everything in reach
settings.text: Positioned so you reach it from the driver's seat without twisting or unbuckling.

settings.title: Two minutes to fit
settings.text: Straps on, straps off. No tools, nothing modified, no permission needed.

settings.question: Will it fit my truck?
settings.answer: Confirmed on Cascadia, 579, T680, VNL and LT. Needs a seat back at least 20" tall and 14" wide with clearance behind the headrest. Dimensions are in Section 5. Measure if you're unsure — 30-day returns either way.

settings.question: Do I have to install anything?
settings.answer: No. Two cam-buckle straps and an anchor strap. About two minutes, no tools. Nothing drilled or bolted.
